title: Refine when selectedcontent elements are updated
body: This is a follow-up to #12263 that addresses the remaining cases where selectedcontent elements were updated too little or too much: * Inserting an option element that causes another option element to become selected now updates selectedcontent elements. This happens when the select element has no selected option, e.g., after setting selectedIndex to -1. * Inserting a select element that already contains option elements now updates its selectedcontent elements once, rather than again from the post-connection steps of its selected option element. * Inserting a selectedcontent element before option elements that change selectedness now updates it once, rather than from both its own post-connection steps and those of the option elements. Its post-connection steps now leave updating it to its select element's pending selectedcontent update, if there is one. * The microtasks queued to update selectedcontent elements after option elements are removed or moved are now coalesced per select element, and do nothing if the selectedcontent elements were updated in the meantime. * Moving a selectedcontent element now queues the same update for its select element, rather than a microtask that updates the moved element from that select element even if it was moved out of it by the time the microtask runs. This also updates the select element's other selectedcontent elements. * Moving a selectedcontent element no longer updates it when its select element and disabledness do not change, e.g., when an ancestor of the select element is moved. * Removing a selectedcontent element now recalculates its disabledness. This also removes "ask for a reset" and "update descendant selectedcontent elements for an option", which would otherwise each have a single caller. Tests: https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/63153 and https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/64258 - [x] At least two implementers are interested (and none opposed): * WebKit * Chromium presumably - [x] [Tests](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt) are written and can be reviewed and commented upon at: * https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/63153 * https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/64258 * https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/65000 - [x] [Implementation bugs](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) are filed: * Chromium: Captcha :-( * Gecko: Still needs to implement. * WebKit: https://bugs.webkit.org/show_bug.cgi?id=325898 and https://bugs.webkit.org/show_bug.cgi?id=329099 - [x] Corresponding [HTML AAM](https://w3c.github.io/html-aam/) & [ARIA in HTML](https://w3c.github.io/html-aria/) issues & PRs: not needed - [x] [MDN issue](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) is filed: not needed, as this only changes when selectedcontent elements are updated - [x] The top of this comment includes a [clear commit message](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/COMMITTING.md) to use.
